Product Details: The KITS4CREATORS Solar Automatic Light Driver Board is a smart and compact controller designed to build automatic solar LED lighting systems. This board charges a 3.7V Li-ion battery using a 6V solar panel during daytime and automatically switches ON the LED at night without any manual operation. The inbuilt TP4056 charging and protection circuit ensures safe battery charging and long battery life. Brightness can be adjusted using the onboard trimpot, allowing users to optimize backup time as per their requirement. This product is intended for DIY users, solar light manufacturers, and educational projects. ⚠️ Important Notes: This is a controller board only. LED, Battery, and Solar Panel are not included in the package. Use only 3.7V Li-ion batteries(18650). Do not use lead-acid or 9V/12V batteries. Use only 6V solar panels (max 6.5V open circuit). 📦 Box Contents: Solar Automatic Light Driver Board User Guide JST Connectors (3 Nos) 2.54mm Pitch
